title: Export all matching salesman currency evidence summaries to Excel
description: Users download current filtered all-matching salesman original-currency evidence summary Excel independently of detail page/field selection and prior preview. Add dedicated export-summary POST endpoint reusing existing request validation/fresh identity-menu-customer-scope/bounded source and ERP-239 pure summaries. Workbook contains currency summary and context worksheets only, no employee/customer detail rows. Currency/known signed decimal amount, assigned approved-order count and distinct salesman count are typed; unknown amount/profit/rate cells are explicit text, never numeric zero. Unknown raw codes/order counts and profit-basis reason remain visible. Formula-safe raw currency labels/context/filter text, stable ordering, explicit empty source and all-matching date/filter/500-order-limit/approved-order basis. No grand totals across currencies or profit derivation. Valid out-of-range detail page still exports complete bounded matching summaries; selected fields may be validated but never remove summary evidence. Designer sends current filters/dates and preserves selected fields/date/page/inputs on invalid/denied/overflow/network failure, returning no workbook. Existing detail Excel/PDF stay page-only. Development only: reuse the existing salesman-output menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted assigned-salesman SalesOrders and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Every endpoint validates current requests and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope, rejecting invalid/revoked/500-order-cap overflow without data/file. Employee filters never broaden ERP permissions. Evidence remains assigned approved sales orders, not all ERP orders, production, actual revenue/shipment/receipts. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Dedicated summary Excel endpoint independently validates and reauthorizes current identity/menu/scope/filters/date/source caps, using server all-matching summaries without relying on preview or detail page.
Summary/context worksheets preserve typed known signed amounts/counts, explicit unknown currency/profit/rate evidence and formula-safe labels, with no detail rows or incompatible grand totals.
Designer downloads current-filter summaries and retains state on errors; workbook/API/UI and detail-export compatibility tests plus safe Release build/test pass.
